name: neuCentrIX Manado
notes: neuCentrIX's official locations page lists a Manado data center; Baxtel places neuCentrIX Manado at Jalan Wiratama No. 2 and describes it as a Tier-2 facility built in 2019 with a 460 sqm footprint and 227 sqm IT hall.

name: neuCentrIX Medan Centrum
notes: neuCentrIX's official locations page lists DC NeuCentrIX Medan Centrum at Jl. Balaikota No.1, Medan; a Telkom neuCentrIX article also covers a director visit to neuCentrIX Medan.

name: Nusantara Data Center Medan
notes: Inflect lists Nusantara Data Center Medan at Jl. Gajah Mada No.32, Simpang Darusalam, Medan, with a stated 2 MW power capacity.

name: CenterServ Medan Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists CenterServ's Medan colocation facility at Regus - Medan, Forum Nine, Petisah Tengah, Medan City; no power or building-size details were provided.

name: neuCentrIX Jayapura
notes: DetikInet reported Telkom's launch of neuCentrIX Jayapura on December 4, 2025, describing it as secure managed storage for local government, health, business and other users in Papua with 24/7 operation and backup power.

name: neuCentrIX Pekanbaru
notes: Telkom's neuCentrIX article says neuCentrIX Pekanbaru was commercially launched on December 16, 2020, is located on Jalan Sudirman, and has capacity for 20 racks.

name: DayOne Nongsa Digital Park Batam campus
developer: DayOne / GDS International, with Indonesia Investment Authority partnership
notes: DayOne's official Batam market page describes a 72 MW data center at Nongsa Digital Park Special Economic Zone, with 68,812 sqm gross floor area and ready-for-service from 2025 onward.

name: NeutraDC Nxera Batam hyperscale data center, Kabil Industrial Estate
developer: NeutraDC Nxera Batam / Telkom Indonesia, Singtel Nxera and Medco Power
notes: NeutraDC's official Batam page describes its carrier-neutral AI-ready Batam facility; a NeutraDC 2026 release says the Batam campus is being developed as a 100 MW data center campus and that capacity was secured before launch.

name: Data Center First Nongsa One, Nongsa Digital Park
developer: Data Center First / Gaw Capital Partners
notes: DCD reported the groundbreaking for Phase 1 of Data Center First's first 30 MW Batam project at Nongsa Digital Park; phase 1 was described as 6 MW of critical IT load across four data halls, with Q4 2023 completion expected at the time.

name: PT Equator Gate System Batam / RangeIDC AI data center, Nongsa
developer: PT Equator Gate System Batam, backed by Range Intelligent Computing Technology / RangeIDC
notes: ANTARA reported BP Batam's announcement of a US$5 billion AI data center investment by EGSB in Batam's Nongsa region, including a PLN Batam electric power purchase agreement and a 30-hectare high-density development plan.

name: GDS / DayOne Nongsa Digital Park campus initial project
developer: GDS Holdings / DayOne and Indonesia Investment Authority
notes: GDS announced its Nongsa Digital Park acquisition in November 2021 with plans for two data center buildings totaling about 10,000 sqm net floor area and 28 MW IT power; later reporting links the project to INA and the broader DayOne Batam campus.

name: Racks Central Batam campus, Nongsa Digital Park
notes: DataCenterMap lists Racks Central Batam as an upcoming greenfield data center in Nongsa Digital Park designed for up to 95 MW of critical IT load for AI, cloud and high-density compute.

name: Matrix Data Center BM1, Batam
notes: DataCenterMap lists Matrix Data Center BM1 at Jl. Citra Lautan Teduh, Tg. Bemban, Batam; Matrix NAP's product page describes Matrix Data Centre services for secure colocation and high-bandwidth connectivity.

name: neuCentrIX Batam Center
notes: neuCentrIX's official locations page lists DC NeuCentrIX Batam Center at Jl. Laksamana Bintan, Baloi Permai.

name: neuCentrIX Banjarmasin-Ulin
notes: Telkom's neuCentrIX article says neuCentrIX Banjarmasin-Ulin launched on April 8, 2021, is located on Jalan Ahmad Yani in Banjarmasin, and has 30-rack capacity.

name: neuCentrIX Makassar
notes: neuCentrIX's official locations page lists Makassar among its Indonesian data center locations; DataCenterMap places neuCentrIX Makassar at Jl. Pajonga Dg. Ngalle No.4, Makassar.

name: IDC Indonesia Makassar, Menara Bosowa
notes: Baxtel describes IDC Makassar as the first public data centre in eastern Indonesia and places it at Jalan Jendral Sudirman No. 5, Menara Bosowa, 6th floor; DataCenterMap also lists IDC Makassar in Menara Bosowa.

name: CenterServ Makassar Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists CenterServ Makassar at Graha Pena, Jl. Urip Sumoharjo, Pampang, Makassar City; no power or gross colocation figures were provided.

name: SM+ Makassar SME04
notes: DataCenterMap lists SM+ Makassar SME04 at Jl. Urip Sumoharjo No.168, Makassar, and describes SM+ as operating edge data centers across Indonesia.

name: Nusantara Data Center Palembang
notes: Inflect and Datacenters.com list Nusantara Data Center Palembang at Jl. Aspol Punti Kayu Km.6/No.7 in Palembang, South Sumatra; Datacenters.com notes ISO 27001 certification but no power details.
